page_title: BAY 2-1 EIN | Bayern Munich v Eintracht Frankfurt 27/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+2' Eintracht Frankfurt control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' We are about to witness a subsitution. Timothy Chandler (Eintracht Frankfurt) for Ellyes Skhiri.
83' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
81' Thomas Tuchel has decided to make a change. Lovro Zvonarek (Bayern Munich) replaces Raphael Guerreiro.
77' Here is a change. Mario Gotze is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Donny van de Beek (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Buta.
76' Neat passing move from Bayern Munich in order to create new attacking opportunities.

74' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
72' A pass by Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. It's a throw-in for Eintracht Frankfurt.
70' We are about to witness a substitution. Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) is replacing Junior Dina Ebimbe.
69' Here comes a substitution. Hugo Ekitike is given a rest as he is replaced by Jean Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt).
69' Thomas Tuchel has decided to substitute Noussair Mazraoui and he is replaced by Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich).
69' That will be all from Joshua Kimmich who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich).
65' Bayern Munich take a short corner kick.
62' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
62' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
62' The referee gives a yellow card to Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
61' 2 - 1 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) puts the ball into the left side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Kevin Trapp.
61' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
60' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniel Schlager had an easy-decision to make.
60' It’s a PENALTY to Bayern Munich after the VAR review!

60' There's a break in play and referee Daniel Schlager must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bayern Munich using VAR. This could be interesting!
59' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
57' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
56' Daniel Schlager couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) and blew his whistle.
55' Bayern Munich have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
54' Great teamplay by Bayern Munich as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
52' A corner kick by Bayern Munich is thwarted by the well prepared Kevin Trapp (Eintracht Frankfurt).

51' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich will have a chance to score from a corner.
50' Eintracht Frankfurt concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
49' A cross, provided by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt), caused no threat to the opposition's defence as the ball was cleared out of danger.
49' A player from Bayern Munich commits a rough challenge. Daniel Schlager blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
48' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
47' Eintracht Frankfurt quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
46' Thomas Tuchel makes a half-time substitution. Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) comes on in place of Matthijs de Ligt.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Daniel Schlager has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Eintracht Frankfurt can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

45' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) fails to beat the keeper from a good chance. He received a nice lofted pass inside the box and shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper deflected the ball onto the post with a quick reaction save and maybe some luck.
43' It's a nice effort by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Manuel Neuer. Easy save.
42' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough foul. Daniel Schlager stops the game and makes a call.
41' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.
39' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.

37' A cross by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
35' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniel Schlager no option but to blow his whistle.

34' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
34' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
30' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
30' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

30' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Kevin Trapp, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
28' A substitution has been made. Konrad Laimer goes off and Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) comes on.
27' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
26' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

23' 1 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt). He perfectly collected a pass from Willian Pacho and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went inside the right post. The score is 1:1.

22' The free kick finds Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) in space in the box, but he can't keep his header down and sends it just wide of the right post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
22' It looks like Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) saw red with that tackle. Daniel Schlager won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

21' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) attempts to find Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
21' Bayern Munich enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike. 63:37 – the ratio of ball possession.
19' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
18' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Manuel Neuer is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
17' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle. Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) commits a foul after dangerous play.
13' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
12' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a rough challenge and Daniel Schlager blows his whistle for a foul.
12' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.

9' 1 - 0 Wonderful movement! Raphael Guerreiro is in a good position inside the box but decides to pass the ball to Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who keeps his cool and blasts the ball inside the left post. What a finish that is – 1:0.
9' Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
7' The game is interrupted now, Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

6' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting provides the assist in the box, but Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
5' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
3' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
2' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The match has just started.
Bayern Munich will kick the game off.
Daniel Schlager will supervise the game today.
